our_interpretation: It refers to ChatGPT with DALL-E 3.
The plain reading covers generating an object with a specified usual part absent, including renewed generation after corrective feedback. It does not require pixel-preserving image editing.
The target period is November 2024, as specified for the underlying experiments.
Excluding an entire object from a scene is a related but different task.
criteria.support_condition: November 2024 records show repeated retention of an explicitly excluded object part despite clear omission or correction instructions.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable tests show the requested parts consistently absent while retaining the rest of the object and satisfying the other material instructions.
